pip-compile.description: The two hashed locks. Renovate reads the pip-compile command from each lock's header, bumps the pin in requirements.in or requirements-dev.in, and recompiles every lock that depends on it.

pip_requirements.description: Off, because pip-compile already updates the .in files, and this manager would bump a lock's pin without recompiling its hashes.

packageRules.description: compose.yaml runs this repo's own image. A bump there would merge itself, release a new version and be proposed again, so that version moves by hand, with the README's.
